assets.prompt: Production environment background asset for MYTHIC CLASH mythological fantasy card game UI, landscape 16:9. Magnificent ancient Greek and mythic stone citadel perched on layered cliffs, immense cascading waterfalls, distant golden temples and a castle, ivy and ruined fluted columns at the extreme left and right edges, tiny warm braziers, lush greenery. Cinematic realistic painterly AAA collectible card game environment. Late afternoon luminous pale gold and blue sky in upper right, cool navy blue water and dark architectural shadows in lower half. Main middle area broad and relatively quiet for UI overlay. Same look as sophisticated game profile with deep navy panels and antique gold details. Architecture and water breathtaking but restrained detail around center. No characters, no text, no logos, no frames, no UI, no cards, no buttons. Full bleed, high quality game environment matte painting.

Single epic heraldic emblem asset for fantasy card game MYTHIC CLASH, transparent background, centered square composition. Majestic sculpted roaring LION HEAD in weathered polished antique gold, surrounded by a dense golden laurel wreath, small blue enamel shield backing, a tiny crown and two subtle stone-carved flourishes. Expensive AAA videogame mode medallion for Guardian of the Arena. Front view, symmetric, convincing thick embossed metal, dramatic natural warm highlights and deep shadows, realistic painterly 3D illustration. Large readable silhouette, exquisite detail at small size. Entire emblem visible with padding around it. NO text, letters, numbers, watermark, buttons, UI or rectangular border. Transparent alpha outside the emblem.
